book_cn: 外研社版选择性必修第二册
unit_cn: Unit 2 Improving Yourself 完善自己
source: 外研社版(新标准)选择性必修第二册 Unit 2 词表(真词);IPA 标准词典英音回填;例句原创、自我提升/改善行为主题、含目标词、贴近本单元;多义词给多个中文释义。

words.example_en: Many users worry about their privacy and information security online.
words.example_cn: 许多用户担心自己在网上的隐私和信息安全。

words.example_en: I switch off my phone before I start studying.
words.example_cn: 开始学习前我会把手机关掉。

words.example_en: After the detox, they were eager to switch on their devices again.
words.example_cn: 脱瘾结束后，他们急着重新打开自己的设备。

words.example_en: A small reward can motivate students to keep a good habit.
words.example_cn: 小小的奖励能激励学生坚持好习惯。

words.example_en: Checking my phone had occupied much of my free time.
words.example_cn: 看手机占去了我大量的空闲时间。

words.example_en: We used to post photos and update our profiles every day.
words.example_cn: 我们过去每天都发照片、更新自己的个人简介。

words.example_en: Endless messages can distract us from real conversations.
words.example_cn: 没完没了的消息会让我们从真实的交谈中分心。

words.example_en: Was I really missing out by constantly checking my phone?
words.example_cn: 不停地看手机，我真的错过了什么吗？

words.example_en: She handed me a clean towel after the swim.
words.example_cn: 游完泳后她递给我一条干净的毛巾。

words.example_en: I was embarrassed to throw in the towel on the very first day.
words.example_cn: 我很尴尬，第一天就认输放弃了。

words.meaning_cn: 接触的机会;使用权;通道
words.example_en: Without access to social media, I could not remember where the party was.
words.example_cn: 没有社交媒体可用，我想不起聚会在哪里。

words.example_en: The detox showed how heavily we rely on our phones.
words.example_cn: 这次脱瘾让我们看清自己多么依赖手机。

words.example_en: We should not rely on social media for every bit of news.
words.example_cn: 我们不该事事都依赖社交媒体获取消息。

words.example_en: I used to be careless and never met my assignment deadlines.
words.example_cn: 我以前很马虎，从不按时完成作业的截止期限。

words.example_en: The book taught me a clever way to beat procrastination.
words.example_cn: 这本书教了我一个战胜拖延的妙招。

words.example_en: We talked about what appropriate behaviour means in public.
words.example_cn: 我们讨论了在公共场合什么是恰当的行为。

words.example_en: We should tell people not to spit in public, as it spreads diseases.
words.example_cn: 我们应提醒人们不要在公共场合吐痰，因为这会传播疾病。

words.example_en: When people talk loudly, I just put my headphones on.
words.example_cn: 有人大声说话时，我就戴上耳机。

words.example_en: I would ask them to put the litter into a rubbish bin.
words.example_cn: 我会请他们把垃圾扔进垃圾箱。

words.example_en: A polite reminder shows you are considerate of others.
words.example_cn: 礼貌的提醒说明你替他人着想。

words.example_en: The school used a clever programme to promote honesty.
words.example_cn: 学校用一个巧妙的方案来提倡诚信。

words.example_en: Let me clarify what I mean by giving you an example.
words.example_cn: 让我举个例子来阐明我的意思。

words.meaning_cn: 媒体报道的热门话题;标题
words.example_en: Recent headlines tell of teens spending too much on online games.
words.example_cn: 近来的热门报道讲述青少年在网络游戏上花钱过多。

words.example_en: Some teens max out their parents' credit cards on games.
words.example_cn: 一些青少年把父母的信用卡刷爆来玩游戏。

words.example_en: In contrast to the big spenders, some teens use money wisely.
words.example_cn: 与大手大脚的人形成对比，有些青少年用钱很明智。

words.example_en: She started making bags for homeless people in her district.
words.example_cn: 她开始为自己所在地区的无家可归者制作袋子。

words.example_en: Inside the bags were necessities such as soap and socks.
words.example_cn: 袋子里装着肥皂、袜子等必需品。

words.example_en: Each bag held toothpaste, soap and a clean towel.
words.example_cn: 每个袋子里都有牙膏、肥皂和一条干净的毛巾。

words.example_en: A bar of soap was one of the most useful items in the bag.
words.example_cn: 一块肥皂是袋子里最有用的物品之一。

words.example_en: These small items helped make poor people's lives a little easier.
words.example_cn: 这些小物品让贫困者的生活轻松了一些。

words.example_en: Some schools teach teenagers how to manage their personal finances.
words.example_cn: 一些学校教青少年如何管理个人财务。

words.example_en: He gave each child a jar for saving and a jar for giving.
words.example_cn: 他给每个孩子一个储蓄罐和一个捐赠罐。

words.example_en: The fourth jar reminds us to invest in ourselves.
words.example_cn: 第四个罐子提醒我们投资自己。

words.example_en: The jars give children a chance to learn lifelong values.
words.example_cn: 这些罐子让孩子有机会学到终身受用的价值观。

words.example_en: Saving gives you a vision for the future.
words.example_cn: 储蓄给你一个对未来的设想。

words.example_en: She saved part of her money, and her brother did likewise.
words.example_cn: 她存下了一部分钱，她弟弟也照样做了。

words.example_en: The jars help teenagers think more objectively about money.
words.example_cn: 这些罐子帮助青少年更客观地看待金钱。

words.meaning_cn: 使有知识和技能;使能够胜任;装备
words.example_en: Good habits equip you to make informed choices in adult life.
words.example_cn: 良好的习惯使你在成年后能做出明智的选择。

words.example_en: Every time the boy lost his temper, he hammered a nail into the fence.
words.example_cn: 男孩每发一次脾气，就往栅栏上钉一颗钉子。

words.example_en: The moderator thanked everyone who took part in the detox.
words.example_cn: 主持人感谢了每一位参加脱瘾活动的人。

words.example_en: The social media detox lasted seven full days.
words.example_cn: 这次社交媒体脱瘾持续了整整七天。

words.example_en: The detox was a fundraising campaign for new sports equipment.
words.example_cn: 这次脱瘾是为新体育器材举办的筹款活动。

words.example_en: The campaign raised awareness of how much we depend on social media.
words.example_cn: 这次活动让人们意识到自己多么依赖社交媒体。

words.example_en: On reflection, I saw how much time my phone had taken up.
words.example_cn: 回头反思，我才看清手机占用了我多少时间。

words.example_en: The boy learnt that it was easier to hold his temper than to hammer nails.
words.example_cn: 男孩懂得了控制脾气比钉钉子要容易。

words.example_en: When you speak in anger, it can leave a hole in someone's heart.
words.example_cn: 你愤怒时说出的话，会在别人心里留下伤口。

words.example_en: The Spending jar teaches that you are responsible for your own happiness.
words.example_cn: 消费罐告诉你，你要为自己的幸福负责。

words.example_en: The detox made me realise the value of real, face-to-face contact.
words.example_cn: 这次脱瘾让我意识到真实面对面交流的价值。
